dhp256:2: yenatthaṁ sāhasā → yen atthaṁ sahasā (pts) | sāhasā → sahasā (cck: sī. syā. ka.)
dhp259:6:
nappamajjati → na tāvatā dharmadharo yāvatā bahu bhāṣate 
yastavīhālapampi śrætvā dharmakāyena vai yathāśen 
sa vai dharmadharo bhavatī yo dharme na pramadyāte (bj: udānavarga 4. 5. 21); na tavata dhamadharo yavata baho bhaṣati 
yo tu apa bi śutvāna dhamu kaphala phasati 
sa ho dhamadharo bhoti yo dhamu na pramajati (bj: pra. dha. A 3 10)
dhp260:1: so →  (sya-all, pts) | hoti → thero hoti (cck: sī. syā.)
dhp260:4:
vuccati → na tena vṛḍo bhavatī yekāsya palitaṁ śiraඃ 
yo vai yuvā’pyadhīyānasataṁdevāඃ sthaviraṁ viduඃ (bj: manusmṛti. 2. 153)
dhp261:4: thero iti → so theroti (sya-all) | iti → ti (pts) | iti → so theroti (cck: syā. ka.)
dhp266:4:
tāvatā → bhikṣurna tāvatā bhavati yācatā bhikṣate parān 
viṣamān dharmān samādāya bhikṣurbhoti na tāvatā (bj: mahāvastu. 3 piṭa 423); na bhikhu tavata hoti yavata bhijati para 
viśapadharma samadai hikhu hoti na tavata (bj: prā. dha. B. 26)
dhp267:4:
vuccati → yastukāmāṁśva pāpaṁ ca dhikkṛtvā brahmacaryavān 
niඃśreṇibhūto saprajño savai bhikṣurti ucyate (bj: mahāvastu 3. piṭa 423); yā tu baheti pavana vata va bramacayiyaca. 
saghai carati loku so tu hikhu tu vucati (bj: prā. dha. B. 27)
dhp271:4:
vivittasayanena → vivicca sayanena (bj, pts) | vā → na śīlavratamātreṇa bāhuśrætyena vā punaඃ 
atha vā samādhilābhena prāntaśayyāsanena ca 
na śīlavatamatrena bahosutena va pano 
adha samadhilabhena vivitaśayanena va (bj: prā, dha. B 22)
dhp272:4:
āsavakkhayaṁ → sapṛhayaṁ naiṣakāmyasukhaṁ apṛthagjanasevitam 
bhikṣu viśvāsammāpado aprāpeta āśravakṣaye (bj: udānavarga); phuṣamu nekhamasukhu aprædhajanasevi 
hikhu viśpaśama ........... apate aśava chaye (bj: prā. dha. B. 25)
